FramingNarrativeConstruction.label: Framing & Narrative Construction
FramingNarrativeConstruction.description: How groups construct and disseminate narratives to shape perceptions, mobilize action, and establish shared understandings. Covers: Narrative Theory & Analysis; Discourse Analysis & Rhetoric; Cognitive Framing & Perception; Creative Storytelling & Performance; Propaganda, Persuasion & Manipulation; Mythology & Archetypal Narrative; History & Historical Interpretation; Cultural Narratives & Identity; Digital Narrative Design & Production; Visual Narrative & Graphic Storytelling; Metafiction & Self-Reflexive Narratives; Ethical Considerations in Narrative; Narrative Structure & Design.

SocialPsychologyOfLeadership.label: Social Psychology of Leadership
SocialPsychologyOfLeadership.description: How leadership emerges within groups, the psychological factors that influence leadership effectiveness, and the impact of leadership on group dynamics.
